objective: [Mejora-TABEJE | FUENTE-FOLIO-DIA] Identificar la fuente de SOLO LECTURA ya existente en EDARSAHUB que pueda entregar folio, fecha/hora de apertura, PAX e importe para Ventas del Dia del 2026-09-29, sin modificar ni ejecutar ningun procedimiento de sincronizacion. Revisar especialmente Comercial_Ventas_Dia_Abiertas_v2 y descubrir tablas/vistas existentes con columnas de folio/cuenta y metricas. Prohibido cualquier escritura, Scheduler, Sync_Sales, Sync_PAX, ISCAM, backfill o acceso POS live.

queries.name: schema_comercial_ventas_dia_abiertas_v2
queries.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND TABLE_NAME='Comercial_Ventas_Dia_Abiertas_v2' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: muestra_comercial_ventas_dia_abiertas_20260929
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 20 * FROM dbo.Comercial_Ventas_Dia_Abiertas_v2 WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE fecha_operacion='2026-09-29' ORDER BY fecha_ultima_actualizacion DESC

queries.name: objetos_con_folio_o_cuenta
queries.sql: SELECT c.TABLE_SCHEMA,c.TABLE_NAME,STRING_AGG(c.COLUMN_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.ORDINAL_POSITION) AS columnas FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c WHERE c.TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND (LOWER(c.COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%folio%' OR LOWER(c.COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%cuenta%' OR LOWER(c.COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%ticket%') GROUP BY c.TABLE_SCHEMA,c.TABLE_NAME ORDER BY c.TABLE_NAME

queries.name: objetos_con_fecha_pax_importe
queries.sql: SELECT c.TABLE_SCHEMA,c.TABLE_NAME,COUNT(*) AS coincidencias FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c WHERE c.TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND (LOWER(c.COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%fecha%' OR LOWER(c.COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%pax%' OR LOWER(c.COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%persona%' OR LOWER(c.COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%venta%' OR LOWER(c.COLUMN_NAME) LIKE '%importe%') GROUP BY c.TABLE_SCHEMA,c.TABLE_NAME HAVING COUNT(*)>=3 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC,c.TABLE_NAME
